kanzAlMahalliRecord.statement: The reviewed Kanz/al-Mahalli record lists seven one-sixth categories: father, grandfather, mother, eligible grandmother, son's daughter with a direct daughter, paternal sister with a full sister, and one uterine sibling, with the compact triggering relationships stated in the review.
